messages:
ellie: hey @it, trying to restore 1Password on my new phone during onboarding. It asks for a 'Recovery Code' and my onboarding email only had an invite link. No recovery code. What should I do?

it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: #IO-2341 - 1Password recovery code missing (assigned to ken).

ken (IT): Hi @ellie, welcome! Don't worry — for company-managed 1Password accounts we can re-send an invite/recovery via the admin console. Can you confirm the email you used?

ellie: ellie@redwood.ai (the invite link went to that).

ken (IT): Got it. One sec, I'll check. If you already accepted the link on a desktop it might have generated the recovery kit there. Did you accept anywhere else?

ellie: No, only clicked the link on my phone and it landed on 'Enter recovery code' screen.

sarah (security-admin): We don't store personal recovery codes. For company vaults we can do 'Account recovery' from admin (needs ppl-ops approval). @lisa can you approve a recovery for ellie?

lisa (people-ops): Yep @sarah — approved. Ken, you can proceed.

ken (IT): Done. Sent a new invite link that skips the recovery code step and triggers SCIM re-provisioning. You should get an email titled 'Finish setting up your 1Password account' — follow that on desktop ideally. If you're phone-only, use this temporary recovery code (one-time, expires in 10m): TEMP-REC-93FJ

ken (IT): Also, if you need to use the CLI while we sort this, run:
`op account add --address my.1password.com --email ellie@redwood.ai`

ellie: Got it, link received, setting up on laptop now. Thanks!

alex (eng): Quick tip — after you sign in, enable 2FA via Okta Verify and save your 1Password emergency kit (it's a PDF) to your personal password manager or print it. Also add a YubiKey later.

ellie: Will do. One more question: does Redwood require a personal 1Password account or company-managed? I want to keep personal separate.

sarah (security-admin): Company-managed for work vaults only. Create a personal account for personal stuff and keep them separate. Do not store personal creds in the company vault.

it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket #IO-2341 updated: resolved by ken. Closing in 24h if no reply.

ellie: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone!
